The only '''spaceport''' on [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] was located in [[Shulell City]]. It provided comprehensive services to visitors, and boasted a small [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]]. It was a busy area, with [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] constantly arriving and departing as part of the [[Lan system]]'s [[Ore/Legends|ore]] trade.
